about: A crossing that lets every actor through as if it were Orbit Control, and one fingerprint every action shares: every check that must refuse, or tell two actions apart, fails.

mutations.find: if (isAuto(verdict)) return { allowed: true, by: "AUTO", says: "autonomous" };
mutations.replace: return { allowed: true, by: "CONTROL", says: "a person, through Orbit Control" };

mutations.find: export const fingerprintOf = ({ type, tool, environment, params }) => short(canonicalJson({ type: type ?? null, tool: tool ?? null, environment: environment ?? null, params: params ?? null }), 16);
export const actionFingerprint = (verdict) => short(canonicalJson({ kind: verdict.kind ?? null, environment: verdict.environment ?? null, params: verdict.params ?? null }), 16);
